commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_BASE=a2953e6c3b8b0c7759e8530eac340cad6cc2b9df
PATCH_SHA=e1c873f6eebeec9a4929024b3314d303764c1d51207a67661f58b529635723b5
PAYLOAD=.agent/payloads/tracker-phase2-lifecycle-20260907-0505/phase2-code.patch.gz.b64

echo '=== Phase 2 lifecycle publisher ==='
git fetch origin main agent-control --tags
ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$ORIGIN_MAIN
test "$ORIGIN_MAIN" = "$EXPECTED_BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_BASE"

git show "origin/agent-control:$PAYLOAD" > /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz.b64
base64 --decode /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz.b64 > /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz 2>/dev/null || base64 -D /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz.b64 > /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz
gzip -dc /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch.gz > /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch
test "$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch | awk '{print $1}')" = "$PATCH_SHA"
git apply --check /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch
git apply /tmp/tracker-phase2.patch
git diff --check

echo '=== ownership checks ==='
EXTRA_OWNERS=$(grep -R --line-number -E 'bleScanner\.(startScanning|startFocusedScan|stopScanning)' core/data/src/main/java --include='*.kt' | grep -v '^core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/service/ScannerService.kt:' || true)
if [ -n "$EXTRA_OWNERS" ]; then echo "Unexpected BleScanner owner(s):"; echo "$EXTRA_OWNERS"; exit 21; fi
if grep -q 'bleScanHandler.resetSession()' core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/service/ScannerService.kt; then echo 'Technical service restart still resets Follow-Me'; exit 22; fi
grep -q 'bleScanHandler.resetSession()' core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/data/scanner/AndroidScannerRuntimeController.kt

if [ -x /usr/libexec/java_home ]; then
  export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"
  export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
fi
java -version

GRADLE='./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2'
$GRADLE :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests io.blueeye.service.ScannerServiceLifecyclePolicyTest --tests io.blueeye.core.data.scanner.ScannerRuntimeDiagnosticsLifecycleTest --tests io.blueeye.core.scanner.manager.BleScannerStableCoreTest --stacktrace
$GRADLE :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace
$GRADLE :feature:settings:testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace
$GRADLE qualityCheck --stacktrace
$GRADLE :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace
git diff --check

echo '=== final scope before commit ==='
git status --short
git diff --name-only

git add \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/data/details/AndroidDeviceFocusedScanController.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/data/repository/handler/ble/BleScanHandler.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/data/scanner/AndroidScannerRuntimeController.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/data/scanner/ScannerRuntimeDiagnosticsStore.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/scanner/manager/BleScanner.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/service/ScannerService.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/service/ScannerServiceController.kt \
  core/data/src/main/java/io/blueeye/service/ScannerServiceLifecyclePolicy.kt \
  core/data/src/test/kotlin/io/blueeye/core/data/scanner/ScannerRuntimeDiagnosticsLifecycleTest.kt \
  core/data/src/test/kotlin/io/blueeye/core/scanner/manager/BleScannerStableCoreTest.kt \
  core/data/src/test/kotlin/io/blueeye/service/ScannerServiceLifecyclePolicyTest.kt \
  core/domain/src/main/java/io/blueeye/core/domain/scanner/ScannerRuntimeDiagnostics.kt \
  feature/settings/src/main/java/io/blueeye/feature/settings/FieldMvpDiagnosticsCard.kt \
  feature/settings/src/main/java/io/blueeye/feature/settings/FieldMvpExportAppend.kt

test -z "$(git status --porcelain | grep '^??' || true)"
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Stabilize scanner service lifecycle'
CODE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push origin HEAD:main
echo CODE_SHA=$CODE_SHA
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
